headline: Fresh Fighting Shakes Central Base Lines
war_summary: The latest ledger shows the struggle shifting toward a handful of unsettled sectors. Linn Mercy has become the sharpest new flashpoint: five base events arrived in the latest two-hour watch, with ownership now eight Colonial, two Warden, and one neutral, against the previous edition’s ten Colonial and one neutral. Weathered Expanse remains highly unstable, though its 24-hour tally has eased from 52 to 51 events; eighteen occurred in six hours and one in the newest watch, leaving six Warden, one Colonial, and two neutral bases. Kuura Strand also renewed activity with one event in two hours and ten across the day, while its casualties and enlistment rate have quickened. Nevish Line’s total has fallen from 68 to 56 daily events and remains quiet in the latest two hours. Marban Hollow has likewise cooled, now at eight events against twelve previously. Callahan’s Passage records no base changes, but it carries the heaviest current combat figures and sharply rising two-hour casualty and enlistment rates. Most other regions show little or no recorded ownership movement.
